notes: Optimization: no more PowerShell spawn every poll when LHM is absent
patch_notes: Optimization pass, no features changed. The WMI temperature route spawns PowerShell - the most expensive probe HeatWatch makes. When it comes back empty (LibreHardwareMonitor not running), the app now remembers the miss for 60 seconds instead of paying that spawn on every 3-second poll; a successful WMI read clears the miss immediately, and all merge results and source labels are exactly as before. New test round 17 covers the cache; all 17 rounds pass.
